And there are many aspects of this energy native to the fourth density that are influencing you upon your planet; and in many ways, this energy guides your development and progress of technology.
excerpts.q: Hi, Q’uo. I have a question. With AI and LLM becoming more and more present in our lives, invoking both interest and apprehension, we are curious about its role in creation at this point in time and in the future. And how can we as positive seekers relate to it. Also wondering about the metaphysical significance and beingness of AI.

excerpts.t: Every being on this planet, every soul, has a balance, a particular balance, a specific and unique balance of these two energetic forces. The divine masculine, which is that which seeks, which is that of power, and which is that of the wisdom element, And the divine feminine, which is that of the receiving, that of the vulnerable, that of the love element.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. Can you speak to the nature and qualities of the divine feminine and masculine principles, and how we might relate to them to deepen our understanding of creation and aid us in serving others? Thank you.

excerpts.t: To do so, we would humbly suggest taking time in silence and witness the events of your day, the thoughts that arose, the feelings you felt. See them with a patient and graceful eye, but an investigative one as well. Note where perhaps the part of you that was firmly grounded in wisdom could have been assisted by a touch of the love. See those moments where you felt perhaps the love element could have used a tad more wisdom.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. Can you speak to the nature and qualities of the divine feminine and masculine principles, and how we might relate to them to deepen our understanding of creation and aid us in serving others? Thank you.

excerpts.t: And as you walk on this shared journey together, you are healing. You are healing yourself. You are healing your other-self. You are healing the planet, and you are healing the universe. This happens in ways seen and unseen.
excerpts.q: Yes, Biondha, thank you for being here with us. In a previous session you said, “We see ourselves as bridges for communication between the third-density being and those of second.” Can you talk more about how you hope to form these bridges of communication? How will serving as a channel for us serve that intention?

excerpts.t: When two other-selves of the same density are interfacing, you can imagine that the potential for growth is quite large. And so in terms of one way an entity may experience that same catalytic opportunity is to take the learnings that one has found in your interactions with other-self and utilize them intentionally in the way you communicate with your second-density other-self. Imagine putting your third-density self in communion in some way with a second-density other-self and embodying that which you may see as a highlight of your third-density communication. And not only that, to gaze upon your second-density self with much respect, with much compassion, and with much hope that the second-density self is much larger than their second-density self. Erase that identity of the label of second density. See them as an other-self with much more potential. […]
excerpts.q: Yes, Biondha, thank you for being here with us. In a previous session you said, “We see ourselves as bridges for communication between the third-density being and those of second.” Can you talk more about how you hope to form these bridges of communication? How will serving as a channel for us serve that intention?

excerpts.t: We are those of Halos and thank you. We find a template of channeling established within this instrument which we make use of, and we would speak first to the latter portion of your query regarding our hopes for the channeling service. We do not expect that these words will be broadcast to or heard by the vast majority of your world. We do not expect that a transcript, as you make it, of our channeling will drop into the laps of warring factions and create for them an epiphany that leads the warring parties from bellicosity to peace.
excerpts.q: Thank you so much, Halos, for being here and for offering your service to us. In a previous session you said: “Among our specialties and strengths is that of the healing of war. The mending of hearts, the constant attempt to beam mercy to those caught in cycles of retribution and bellicosity.” Thank you for offering yourself to our planet at this particular time. […]

excerpts.t: See the world through their eyes, how vast, how exciting, how scary; and see the way that they show up in unconditional love and service to one another, to the planet—and perhaps you, too, may feel inspired to take the cloak, the cane, and to be an additional shepherd of that unconditional love, to be a way-shower, and to help inspire those around you to be more present in their own experience; to witness the planet in its full glory, the universe as well, and to see the beauty of the illusion and the love that created it all.
excerpts.q: Yes, Biondha, thank you for being here with us. In a previous session you said, “We see ourselves as bridges for communication between the third-density being and those of second.” Can you talk more about how you hope to form these bridges of communication? How will serving as a channel for us serve that intention?

excerpts.t: We would also suggest the universal option for all experience, and that is love. Let us say that you have had experiences, as we have mentioned prior, of trauma, of pain, love lost, unmet expectations. Find love. Find grace for yourself. See the beauty. As our friends of Ra had said, note the seeming coincidences that have brought you to that moment. Are they not divine? Love that which you felt bound to, that which you felt [to be] heavy. Invest love in that, hold it with love and appreciation.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you. How could we learn to truly let go?

excerpts.t: For the collective vibratory rate only changes insofar as individuals move from fear to love; heal fear to allow love; have the courage to love regardless of the fear; have the discernment to recognize the difference between fear and love; have the vision to see the world through the uplifting, God-revealing eyes of unconditional, universal love.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a question, Q’uo. And the question is, do we need to attain global peace on Earth in order for Earth to transition to fourth density? And what spiritual principles would be involved when we deal with questions like this?

excerpts.t: But again, we encourage you, if you have discovered your own self judging the self, to have compassion for all aspects of the self in that dynamic: the judger and the judged. For all things are proper for the entity in their time. And in discovering the judgment that you render towards yourself, you discover judgment that you might render towards another. And in healing and accepting those aspects of the self that are judged, that are seen as wrong and as failures, you may then turn that perspective outward and more easily discover love within the so-called or so-perceived failures of others. You will recognize upon your own journey that each other-self has a similar journey with similar difficulties.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, we have a query. Could you please suggest practices which might help us to realize oneness with the Creator and perhaps add insight in how we might alleviate spiritual pride or arrogance?

excerpts.t: We would take this opportunity to note what each within the circle knows, and that is wherefrom peace springs, where it begins. As was explored in an earlier moment of this gathering in the phrase, “What is an ocean but a multitude of drops?” What is global peace but a multitude of peace holders, a multitude of beings such as those within this circle, such as those living from the open heart around your planet embodying, vibrating, and exemplifying peaceful beingness.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a question, Q’uo. And the question is, do we need to attain global peace on Earth in order for Earth to transition to fourth density? And what spiritual principles would be involved when we deal with questions like this?

excerpts.t: We call it an illusion because it is not able to show you the truth of the unity of all things, because you exist within the veil of forgetting. And this veil of forgetting could be seen as something that is harmful to you because it keeps you from seeing the truth. But in truth, it is that which is most helpful to you, for as you work your way through this type of a veil of forgetting, you are moving forward on your spiritual path. When you have difficulties, perhaps you will move backward for a step until you use that difficulty and grow from it.
excerpts.q: Yes Q’uo, there is a question. It is tempting to believe that as negative and hopeless as our third-density illusion may appear in space/time, it is just as positive and hopeful in time/space. Can you tell us if there’s any truth to that, or is it just wishful thinking? Can you comment on these spiritual principles that may be involved in this?

excerpts.t: But in hard circumstance, and in that which takes you to the limits of your abilities, you may strengthen your will and faith that you may serve others, that you may seek the One. This will and faith is both greater than any individual responsibility and the sum of all responsibilities. It is prior to space and time. The twin dynamics of will and faith operating in tandem are the conduit to the Creator. That [very same] will and faith can be applied to your seeming mundane life.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a query. And thank you so much, Q’uo, for being here with us. How can one best manage the will to seek self-realization of intelligent infinity with the demands and responsibilities of daily earthly life, especially since the will for this seeking activates the need to release attachments?

excerpts.t: Instead, you can see it sourced within and of and from the Creator Itself. There is no way for you to get outside of this Creator. There is no way for you to interact with something other than the Creator. This is just as true of your responsibilities. These are magnificent opportunities, and they need not get in the way of your seeking of the Creator.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a query. And thank you so much, Q’uo, for being here with us. How can one best manage the will to seek self-realization of intelligent infinity with the demands and responsibilities of daily earthly life, especially since the will for this seeking activates the need to release attachments?

excerpts.t: The method that was requested within this query is to pay attention and to ensure that you use these moments to not just reflect upon the self, but to offer your service and your healing and attempt to manifest your intention to love again and again and again. You may fail again and again, but with each attempt, the Creator joins you. And each time you attempt, the potential that you carry to heal grows and more and more, the healing that you seek comes closer. This is the great work of third density.
excerpts.q: Yes, there’s a question. Considering the adept or relatively well-balanced self experiences catalysts from other-self (be it partner, boss, child) which opens unexpected, old wounds, which causes inner, cognitive, emotional turbulence. What is the recommended method to recover quickly, without causing verbal, physical or mental damage?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am now with this instrument. We express again, through this instrument, our gratitude to be invited to join this circle. And we express our gratitude to the instruments present for their fidelity to the tuning process and the challenging process that helps us to enter this space and join you. We would also offer gratitude to this instrument for offering us a reminder to express a request of this circle and all who may become aware of our words. And that is simply that you take what we share with what you call a grain of salt, you may say, in that you utilize your discernment in receiving and integrating our responses so that you rely upon your own faculties to determine the truth, and not rely upon us as authorities to hand you the truth pre-packaged, you may say. […]

This involves, during this time of transformation and transition from the third density to the fourth density, much, much catalyst. And this catalyst is increasing upon your surface planet, as we know many here are aware. We emphasize again that how you view this catalyst, how you understand your place upon this planet, and how you predict what the future may bring for your planetary population and for you is itself catalyst for you to use as a gift, for you to understand as a reflection of your own beingness.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. What can you tell us about the potential future of humanity and the role that we will play in it?

excerpts.t: We are those known to you as the principle of Q’uo, and it is with peace in our hearts that we interface with this circle, this circle of seekers who exist in a world that more often than not seems to exhibit anything but peace. And before we would get underway, we would remind each of the oasis that awaits one within that is of peace and stability in a world that, as it is perceived to the senses, may at times seem to be tearing itself apart.

Take these moments where you struggle into meditation and see the beauty of what you have offered, even in those moments that have not had the ending you planned. Recognize the beauty of the support. Even though it may not seem in that moment that you did truly touch that heart in some way, and that that service, though maybe not felt in this moment on this planet, redounds outward to the universe and is felt in those beautiful moments of life between lives. Your service is ultimately a record, a book, if you will, of love.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a question. When we step in to help another person along the path, at what point does our intervention support their free will, and when might it unintentionally override it?

excerpts.t: I am, Q’uo, and I am aware of your query, my sister. The primal Logos of this infinite creation can also be seen as the Creator, and this primal Logos subdivides itself into a Logos, or a word that is a galaxy, such as your Milky Way Galaxy. There are infinite numbers of galaxies that contain various sub-Logoi such as your sun body, so that each entity that is a sun is a sub-Logos of a Logos such as the Milky Way Logos, which has 250 billion sun bodies such as your sun. Within it, there are an infinite number of these Logos entities that are in the Infinite Creation.
excerpts.q: I am unfamiliar with the term Logoi, if there’s a way to describe that.

excerpts.t: You commonly view in your third-density illusion, the spectrum of colors that you identify with the rainbow. And this is such with the energy centers within your body. This manifestation of seven colors, you may say, each having a true identity and a true quality that informs your entire being, beginning with the root chakra or energy center. That red-ray energy center that is focused upon the most primal beingness of your essence in creation, and that is that of survival, that of reproduction, the continuation of life, the foundation upon which life can exist within the creation. This is a constant and consistent energy center, and is necessary for all subsequent life to take place. For the Creator to continue its stance through creation, it must perpetuate Itself within the creation, and this is the nature of the red-ray energy center.
excerpts.q: I have a question, Q’uo. Thank you for taking my question. I’m very honored to be here. And I would like to ask if you would consider giving a teaching on the chakra system of the human form, if it’s not too much to ask.

excerpts.t: For each of you is more than a third-density being. You are more than you feel you are. You are moving into the fourth density of love and understanding. So this process of the Big Bang continues to reverberate into the fourth density of love and understanding, and then into the fifth density of wisdom or light. This continues into the seventh density of foreverness. And again, all entities and beings and matter itself begins to condense into the One Infinite Creator in the eighth density of foreverness, or the black hole that is the final bang within this octave of densities. And then the entire process begins again and goes on forever and ever, as it has been doing forever and ever. The bang begins, the bang proceeds, the bang completes, and it is all done in the mystery of the unity of the One Infinite Creator that exists within each being, within the circle of seeking.
excerpts.q: Yes. If the Big Bang was considered to be the beginning, and Derry Lewis’s Great Attractor considered to be the end, what is the assumption that the universe is moving towards the Great Attractor as infinity returning to source of the Infinite Creator?

excerpts.t: Moving further, we arrive at the green-ray energy center, that pivotal energy center of your current experience within the third density. That energy center that you as a peoples are attempting to open within your third-density incarnation to allow the love of the Creator to become present within your beingness and to become aware of that presence. This is the energy center of universal love—of love freely given. To open this energy center is to realize that all deserves love, that you have the capacity to give love to the creation. However, this energy center may become baffled within the creation. For love alone can often be confusing within an illusion, such as you experience, when it is not effective, when it reaches blockage or denial.
excerpts.q: I have a question, Q’uo. Thank you for taking my question. I’m very honored to be here. And I would like to ask if you would consider giving a teaching on the chakra system of the human form, if it’s not too much to ask.

excerpts.t: And in order to explore this, we would point out the nature of the heart and its relationship to the green-ray energy center. That energy center, as you are aware, is of love and understanding, of compassion and empathy and acceptance. These are qualities of the green-ray energy center, and in addressing the type of catalyst that you have described, we would offer the perspective that energy centers [can be distorted not only] in that they can be blocked, but they can also be overactive.
excerpts.q: Thank you so much, Q’uo. Can Q’uo speak to what the spiritual meaning or lessons of physical challenges of the heart might be? How might these physical challenges relate to the seeker’s work in balancing love and wisdom through the energy centers?

excerpts.t: This process of working with dreams is a process of living a dream, within the dream of third density, and making progress in understanding how you are a many-faceted jewel that will be coming back to meet yourself in greater and greater forms, in feelings, in thought, in any way that you can understand more of how you are the dream.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. We have one sent in from a seeker named E, who writes: “I am aware that dreams are fertile ground for growth and work in consciousness, but I struggle to know what I am to learn or gain from them. I feel any of my guesses are just that, wild guesses. […]

excerpts.t: Of course, this takes a certain aspect of will on the social memory complexes part to access it. And there is an exchange as they receive it. They also offer it their own experiences, and the needs of that social memory complex will dictate what is available to them in that moment. For it would be unnatural for a social memory complex to play or be curious, you may say, with such a repository. For as you enter into the fourth density and continue progressing along that path, the desire to serve others becomes so great that satisfying one’s curiosity is no longer a question, but rather the need to further the service to others is the most pressing need of a fourth-density social memory complex, and most fifth-density and sixth-density social memory complexes as well.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have another question in a series of questions about the concept of a social memory complex. In 16.32 of The Ra Contact, Ra says each member of the Confederation of Planets voluntarily places its social memory complex data in a social thought complex available to all. Can you say more about the central data repository and what it contains? […]

excerpts.t: Although there are meaningful differences between the unity among the Confederation and the unity found within a social memory complex, this repository contains anything that any member of the Confederation could desire to discover to learn. There are lessons taught among the densities and between the densities within the Confederation. But for those entities and social memory complexes of the Confederation who travel outward and attempt to serve planets, particularly those planets of the third density, they may easily call upon this repository for any type of information that might be helpful to them.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have another question in a series of questions about the concept of a social memory complex. In 16.32 of The Ra Contact, Ra says each member of the Confederation of Planets voluntarily places its social memory complex data in a social thought complex available to all. Can you say more about the central data repository and what it contains? […]

excerpts.t: Perhaps you are not able to accept those who are causing the turmoil, and yet they are the Creator too. They are giving you a chance to grow, and by growing, we mean loving them as the Creator, looking past the third-density illusion of seeing them as separate from anyone else. This is the path that each of you travels in the third density. There will be one form of turmoil or another in your spiritual path, very, very frequently, for this is the third density with the veil of forgetting, which you must pass through and forget that all is one. By that forgetting, then, you get catalyst that helps you to grow and remember more by balancing the difficulties with your love, the anger with your love, the division with your love. Your love is the Creator’s love flowing through you, and it is a powerful love when you direct it with your free will.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I have a question. In these times of turmoil, how can we consciously balance the distortions of love and wisdom so that we progress more harmoniously upon the path of service to others?

excerpts.t: That, my friends, is perhaps the greatest gift of these earthworks, that they provide some kind of chronology of spiritual seeking. They are but a knot in a very long thread that goes throughout what you call time. A rope, if you will, by which seeker upon seeker may climb to new heights through the means of inspiration to see oneself in a greater universe, to see how each one thinks, to question how each other thinks.
excerpts.q: I am very interested in the earthworks that are left over from some civilization that we don’t know about. Are you able to offer any insider information as to their origin, and what the people were like that made them? And do these earthworks have any utility for the people that live now?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am with this instrument at this time. We are here in the feelings of love that you have created in your round robin, and we are basking in these feelings, for that love is part of the Creator’s love that made all that there is out of love. We thank you all for sharing your hearts and for taking the time to come here, taking time out of your busy schedules, where the nature of the unity of all things is not so clear. And yet when you come here, or in any such group, you are with those of like mind which can enhance your perception of the truth of the unity of you with everyone else and with the Creator. For the Creator has made all that there is to be expressed through you in a way that helps the Creator to know Itself.
excerpts.q: Balancing love and wisdom; turning the other cheek; spiritual dimension of Hawking radiation; 3I/Atlas and its implications; mission of service through paranormal experiences and seeker support; the nature of humility; mysterious ancient stoneworks and their present-day meaning; healing, soul design, and challenging circumstances; energetic sensitivities in service to others.

excerpts.t: To further hone this exercise, we would humbly suggest the practice of meditation. As you know, we speak quite frequently about this particular practice. However, we would caveat that by saying that going into the silence with the intention of finding that stillness of self that is part of every other-self, sitting in that stillness and witnessing the unity that exists that is beyond the illusion, that is beyond the separation that one may witness outside of the space of silence, taking in that warm feeling, that hug, if you will, of the Creator’s love that sees the quality, that sees the even playing ground, and that sees the unity and oneness of all things. Really, genuinely sitting in that space, experiencing, remembering it, and taking note of how that feels within the practice of meditation.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. What is the true nature of humility and how can embracing it lead to greater spiritual growth and connection with the Law of One?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my brother. In general, we may say that the higher densities from the fourth through the seventh have a social memory complex that operates as a social memory complex. However, within the fifth density of light or wisdom, it is possible for each member or any member of a social memory complex to move in an unique fashion seeking ways to know itself better as the Creator as it travels the journey seemingly alone, yet not truly alone, but in a sense that does not reflect the total unity of the social memory complex.
excerpts.q: Yes, in moving through the densities, does one necessarily become part of a social memory complex or are there others who are lone practitioners who work on themselves without being part of the larger group?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and am aware of your query, my sister. Yes, we would suggest when you feel there are any dark energies or entities or concepts that are, shall we say, taking aim upon you and your life experience, that you enter into the state of meditation. And with your heart open, send your love to these entities, surround them with your love. For they do not like to be loved. They are from an area of their own consciousness that is separate from others and wishes to control others. Send them your love with the feeling of true love for them, for they are the Creator. They are your other-selves; they just do not know that. And after you have done that, surround yourself in an armor of light and wish them well from your heart.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I’m wondering, if possible, how one can protect themselves from darker entities or negative spiritual activity when one feels subject to such thing?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. The life-between-life experiences within your third density give you a chance to review the life just lived with your higher self or your guides so that if you should decide to return, you can see where there might have been refinements that you could have made in your previous life experience. Refinements that will perfect your desire to see the Creator in all and to continue moving through the densities where you become closer and closer to unification with the One Creator so that, in each higher density, there is a refinement of this review of the incarnation. But it does not require your work with higher selves as much as it does with your work with yourself, for there is no veil of forgetting in the higher densities.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. My question is about the so-called life between lives. After we leave third density, many of us believe that we go on to an experience between lives where we review our past life. And eventually, we have a chance to have another existence in third density if we want, if we can take it. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. In those moments when you step off the path of love and take a detour into anger, we would suggest that you review that stepping off the path into anger in your meditation. See where you were before you stepped off the path. See what caused you to step off the path. Look at that as a portion of your spiritual journey that can be enhanced when you see that more potently within your own being, so that you can feel that anger yourself rather than feeling it for someone else.
excerpts.q: I have one last question. Occasionally, more so recently, I feel in the role of a protector. However, often times I feel I drift into anger. How do I redirect back into love more efficiently and remove myself from anger?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. Forming social memory complexes is the work of third density so that various portions of the One Infinite Creator may bind themselves together by the love of the One Infinite Creator, and see the Creator and everyone around them. So that they may help the Creator to know Itself in a more advanced form, what you call, a social memory complex.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. How important is it to form positively oriented social memory complexes at this time on the earth? And why is it, if so, why is it important?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my sister. This is the work of your third-density illusion. For you have what many call a kind of intellectual knowledge that could be seen at your level of existence as a wisdom, and yet it has that which lacks wisdom, and that is the limits of your knowledge. For the intellect is confined to the third-density illusion. So once you are able to move your heart in an open-hearted way that sees all as the Creator in whatever experience you are having, whatever experience you hope to have, this open heart leads you to the fifth-density of light, which is the wisdom density that sees beyond all boundaries of the third-density illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a question. How can we consciously balance love and wisdom to progress more harmoniously on the path of service to others?

excerpts.t: Rather, these are differentiations of progress within the time/space or inner planes realms of your third-density experience. For there is, even within this one density, a great spectrum of experience, including those which you have identified in your question. And as the entity moves forward, whether in the incarnational experience or those who live strictly within the inner planes, they also move upward and with accompanying greater awareness and greater ability, greater capacity to channel the love and the light of the One Creator and express mastery as well in their experience of their own native realm.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a question from T. He says: “In Dr. Michael Newton’s book Destiny of Souls, he references levels of spiritual advancements, two through five. After these are levels six through nine, which refer to ascending masters. Do these correspond, in some fashion, to densities, as described in The Law of One? If not, how and why are there differences? […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and yes, my brother. This does indeed make sense. For a place or a site such as this home was spoken of by those of Ra as a third type of being that may be invested with the love of those who inhabit that home, so that it may become a third-density being. This particular home, as many know, was already blessed before anyone moved here in 1984 when those known as Don, Carla, and Jim moved here. […]
excerpts.q: Yes, I believe she’s referring to the last time we were here. The one known as Jim was referring to the way that a home such as this one may be able to graduate, and so I believe what she’s referring to is whether being able to engender or being able to bring a site or a place into a further state of advancement would shift the thinking of not just that site, but the person who may be dwelling […]

excerpts.t: We realize in that metaphor that we are speaking of a certain communication style, but that particular dynamic can be true of the way a seeker experiences their experience—that there is catalyst; that there is friction; that there is challenge, or that there is bliss; and instead of allowing the self to sit in that experience, the seeker, instead, attempts to meet that experience in a similar fashion. When the seeker feels pain, the seeker puts attention on that pain and the seeker potentially causes more pain, for instance, reacting out of pain, perhaps inflicting pain upon others in response to that pain.
excerpts.q: Hello, Biondha. I see the art of listening as a very important and often undemonstrated spiritual practice. How do we listen more deeply to ourselves and to others and to the Creator?

excerpts.t: This awareness is important to hold because prayer and meditation and contemplation are not mechanical acts or technical procedures—they are expressions of faith. Faith is not the straw to which one clings as an act of hopelessness. Faith is not desperation, though desperation, indeed, may precipitate and inspire a true act of faith.
excerpts.q: Okay, thank you. I figured that was the case. I have a question. I’d like to continue exploring your focus of helping to alleviate the disharmony of war and bellicosity. The Confederation has affirmed, in various ways, the power of prayer and meditation in aiding peace on our planet. […]

excerpts.t: This is not a faith which grants one the ability to order the universe, or correct its wrongs or distortions, but to see to the true situation behind and beneath the mirage of the illusion of separation. And in this clear seeing, there is a fundamental basis of acceptance, of love and acceptance. This includes love and acceptance in the face of all which transpires on the surface of your planet in the way of harm and war and disharmony. There is a peaceful acceptance of the Creator manifesting Itself in the light and the dark.
excerpts.q: Okay, thank you. I figured that was the case. I have a question. I’d like to continue exploring your focus of helping to alleviate the disharmony of war and bellicosity. The Confederation has affirmed, in various ways, the power of prayer and meditation in aiding peace on our planet. […]

excerpts.t: Rather, it is our desire and our directive to reach individuals and attempt from the ground up to ensure that love blossoms, and that it is love that then reveals this technology to you as a peoples so that it may be expressed and shared once it is made available with that heart of love.
excerpts.q: That was very satisfactory, particularly regarding the entity’s one directive, so to speak, regarding the harvest being to seek the heart of self regardless of, or even more importantly in response to, the circumstances one is experiencing. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and now with this instrument. We reiterate through this instrument our gratitude for being invited to join you in your circle of seeking. From a limited perspective, it may seem as though you gather with a desire to receive that which we have to offer. However, we recognize a fuller dynamic at play as you come together as seekers—that your desire is not just to receive, but also to radiate. This desire is innate in your hearts, as you share your beingness through your round robin. It is innate in your very desire to receive what we have to offer, for we recognize that as seekers upon the path of service to others, your desire to receive is indeed a desire to inform and refine and purify that which you radiate out into your world.

Why should it only be something that occurs in one’s mind? Why not have it be an expression outside of oneself, one that is not stifled, one that is as unbounded as the creation about you, one that transcends even that which one can see? When one can see one’s self as worthy of that, when one can see oneself as the expression of the Creator and the creation, then one can also allow oneself to be creativity itself, to be the magician working one’s magic. And though in certain situations one’s surroundings are challenging, the magician may work their creative magic to see beyond this failed illusion. To part the curtain, if you will, and see the magic, the beauty, the wonder, the imperfect perfection, and to feel the love that drives all that is around you.
excerpts.q: After one is finished channeling, there’s often a sense of residue of things unexplored, nuances or aspects that didn’t get conveyed. And I was thinking about our spiritual seeker and friend and wanderer in war-torn, or maybe not war-torn, but conflict-heavy area of Iran. […]

excerpts.t: But what this power, love, and wisdom—this infinite energy within—can do is to expand the container of consciousness within which these challenging catalysts occur in the self so that the flash of anger and hatred that may wish to do harm to the harm-giver, or the moment of despair, or the overcoming with tears in the witness of loss, personal or otherwise, may be held within the self with respect and honor in a heart of love. Love for that which one is experiencing, love for others in clear-seeing of the ignorance with which others commit their harm.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they […]

excerpts.t: Then the realization will dawn that it is indeed perfect, even though it may, from a human level, hurt. And it may, from a human level, seem like the most difficult and awful experience. But from the infinite scale of the One Infinite Creator and the infinite love of the Creator, it, too, is fully imbued with the love and perfection of that One Infinite Creator.
excerpts.q: Yes, my question is, how best to integrate the human element with the spiritual? Particularly as we transcend and our dense bodies become lighter and our spiritual bodies seek out even greater dimensions of reality. How do we keep those from separating into two distinct realities?

excerpts.t: But to turn more to the heart of your query, it is indeed an ever present dynamic of the third density, for even those entities who may exist within that peaceful day that we referred to earlier, will not exist within that peace forever. Even though they may never become aware of the suffering elsewhere, suffering will visit them in one way or another. It is impossible within your density for most seekers to avoid suffering. It is impossible to relieve yourself of this suffering, for indeed, it is the purpose of your density to experience the suffering in one way or another, to allow the Creator in which there is no suffering, to trick Itself into believing that such suffering is real, that such suffering does take place in some form of reality.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. The news in our world is often of a disharmonious or upsetting or even heartbreaking nature. So this question is about the relationship of the seeker to news. Too much of it, and we risk despair or depression or disempowerment. Too little of it, and we become isolated and disconnected in a bubble of our own private world from the suffering of others. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we feel that we have a query, that you might like to know why this is necessary and how it is helpful. What we would say is that you must remember that in the third density you live in an illusion. It is the illusion created by the veil of forgetting. If you were not in the third density and were beyond that veil of forgetting, you would look back and see all of the suffering was appropriate. The Creator is knowing Itself. And when all are beyond the veil of forgetting, we will continue to move forward through the higher densities where there is no veil, there is no feeling of suffering, there is more and more the feeling and the knowing and the being of the Creator in oneself and in all things.
excerpts.q: I’m not sure how to ask this, but I just wish the Creator could know Itself without such suffering and pain and destruction.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and am aware of your query, my brother. You have spoken of those creatures of the second density that live upon each other. This is a way that a portion of the Creator discovers a way to further its journey, by consuming another portion of the Creator. And that portion of the Creator being consumed knows what it is like to feed another portion of the Creator, and the Creator sees how one is fed and one is eaten.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I’ve been practicing seeing all beings as the Creator. I have enjoyed seeing the birds and trees and other parts of nature on our property as parts of the Creator. Yesterday, I was watching the birds, and suddenly a hawk swooped down out of nowhere and tried to snatch one of the birds. […]

excerpts.t: So to say that Jesus was either fully physically actualized or not is perhaps not the most important question. But more importantly is, “What does this figure represent?” That is the more full picture of who this Jesus is. Perhaps Jesus is a fully actualized physical being who walked this planet, whose name was [in the Greek version] Jesus, who was born of a virgin birth, miraculously. And perhaps Jesus was an idea, a seed of perhaps channeled energy that was manifest through multiple entities at converging times; that messages came through one or many entities, is, we could see, very important to the seeker, especially those of the Christian religion, to see this empowered, enlightened self as a speaker for the higher realms, to see them as a spokesperson for unity and love. And so we understand that desire to know this entity as Jesus.
excerpts.q: Yes, I have a query. It was triggered by the mention of myth. I’m reading a book now called “The True Origins of Jesus: The Myth Behind the Man.” And I don’t know, it may be too involved to comment here, I don’t know. But anyway, is there a possibility, I guess, that Jesus was strictly a spiritual being, not necessarily a fully physical being? […]

excerpts.t: You ask about different applications of sound healing in the service to others, including the intuitive playing as you have described, and the other more specific frequency, asking what the impact and consequences and ultimate help these different modalities may be. We may counsel you, our brother, that the healer—whatever may be their particular modality, whether they are the allopathic or naturopathic or psychological or music-making type of healer—has a variety of tools in their tool belt, shall we say. Part of the great art of serving as catalyst, that is, serving as one who offers the healing catalyst, is in practicing the faculty of empathy and presence such that one may intuit the request for service from the other-self or other-selves and respond accordingly.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? […]

excerpts.t: Music is a very powerful way to give voice to this love that encompasses all things, music and sound generally. For the being has rational, logical, analytical, and language-based faculties and modes. And this, in the integrated being, is woven into the larger whole. But the being expands far beyond the limitations of the rational mind and the logic-bound mind, and music and sound on a very primal level may speak to these other and deeper and wider aspects of beingness.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? […]

excerpts.t: My sister, we would also say that you develop an ability to trust yourself in these experiences. Do they feel magical? Trust that magic. Do they feel inspiring? Follow that inspiration. And in moments when it is hard fought to find the magic or the inspiration, we stress that you have much grace for yourself. If the answers are not fully clear in that moment, have no fear, my friend, your experience is always evolving and moving, and pieces are in constant flux, fading in and out, repositioning themselves with the ultimate and always present forward movement.
excerpts.q: I have a query, Q’uo. This is concerning dreams, visions with possible prophetic meaning. My question is kind of two parts. First, is there a benefit to receiving such information? And the second part is, would you encourage someone to investigate this further?

excerpts.t: We would humbly suggest that those instances, where the word or the visualization does not make a whole lot of sense, are confusing or are unfamiliar, that familiarity will come with your time. It will come with investigation, or may come with simple, loving acceptance that at this time I may not know, but that in time as I am the Creator knowing Itself, it will become clear. Instances like these are gifts to the Creator as well, as you can imagine. The Creator is ever expanding and refining Its own processes further knowing Itself and through your experience, reliving and appreciating the magic of the creation.
excerpts.q: I wish I had written my questions down now. I’ll see if I can clarify because I know I asked about the benefit, and then I guess my other part to this is just that when you’re given words through a vision unfamiliar to you that you’re curious about and then you investigate, and then later maybe something happens that comes to fruition. I don’t know. Is there an action I should take? Sorry. […]

excerpts.t: This seeming connection is due to the fact that, for an entity to polarize service to self, there is a need to master, you may say, the energies of these lower energy centers towards a certain end. There is a need, through a great strength of will, to avoid and close off the self from that influence of the green ray that would be experienced within the heart chakra of the entity, and instead bolster the energies of the lower energy centers absent of this green ray influence.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I didn’t expect that there was any riddle there or hidden meaning, but rather just that the syntax got messed up in transmission, but it’s only a guess. Yes, in my personal opinion, there seems to be widespread confusion regarding differentiating behaviors that exhibit as service to self and those that exhibit as service to others, even and especially among those awakening to spiritual […]

excerpts.t: These two energies exacerbate each other, you may say. The more that you have the ability to avoid suffering within the self and avoid witnessing the suffering of others, the more opportunity is invited to impress upon you that suffering of self or other.
excerpts.q: That was on point. Thank you, Q’uo. Yeah, a simpler follow up to that question. You describe the appropriate relationship of the third-density entity to fourth-density energies as one of allowance and acceptance. And on paper that sounds so easy, you know: expand the heart; welcome more peoples into the heart; recognize our interconnectedness; love your neighbor, etc. […]

excerpts.t: This is the aspect of the quote that we feel is most important: that the wanderer, that soul from a higher density who has already experienced third density, may look upon the incarnational plan to travel back and wander into third density with some strong desire to serve. And this desire to serve can be overpowering, even overwhelming, for this higher-density entity [generating] the motivation to then incarnate, and attempt to serve a planetary population such as yours that has found itself swirling, you may say, within a certain cycle of regression and catalyst presented by that regression. This can create a very powerful pull. […]
excerpts.q: There are more questions, Q’uo. First, a quick housekeeping note, there will just be two channels today it seems, so you can divide up your time accordingly. Kind of related to this subject, it’s complex, apologies. In #12.28, Ra is talking about the purity of mind and the foolhardiness/bravery necessary for the higher-density soul to wander to this planet. […]

excerpts.t: This will require more and more catalyst of greater and greater degrees, for it must increase in its intensity to draw the attention of the individual and to break through, you may say, to the hardened protection around the heart that has been built by the energies of the orange and yellow rays. But this catalyst can work, and if your planetary population were not able to grasp it and utilize it, then it would not be present. The potential of your planetary population is what manifests the degree of this catalyst.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you, Q’uo. It’s good to be with you. I think these might be the last of my world-focused questions for a bit. I find myself of two minds at times. My spiritual heart senses the movement toward the fourth density of love and understanding; and I see so much evidence of the global awakening increasing, as it has been for decades. […]

excerpts.t: But faith, as we intend it, is not a belief in a set of ideas. Faith is not even necessarily belief of, or in, that known to you as the Law of One text. Instead, faith is that which connects you—you being this illusory, separate entity of mind, body, and spirit—to your true nature in and as the One. This faith, as we have conveyed before, expresses itself in the being, in the awareness, and in the incontrovertible surety that all is well. Whether it be life or death, good times or difficult times.
excerpts.q: Yeah, thank you, Q’uo. This query I’ve been trying to form as you’ve been talking, so I apologize if it’s not fully formed. But within that response, you recognized faith with terms such as formless, absent of resistance, totally free, unthinking. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and I’m again with this instrument. We offer our gratitude at having been extended the invitation and then accepted into the circle of seeking. It is with great joy that we have been able to, through these instruments, speak to these concepts that are upon the minds of seekers, that are relevant to the path of the seeker, and we hope that our words find their way into the hearts of all who read them so that they may better inform your journey upon a planet that is attempting to evolve and transform into the next density and provide an environment of love and understanding for the entities upon it.

Is it clearer, or, in your logical terms, more effective to see and analyze and study the shadows shaking upon the surface? Or to step out from that cave and see the light source which was creating their shadows? To recognize that that light source is within the self and is ultimately the self. This is the same light source that underlies any moment in any incarnation within third density, and every moment of any place the entity’s feet may take them through the multi-dimensional journey of the birth and death of densities and octaves and entities and places. To such an entity who has learned to abide in faith, they are free and liberated from the constraints and strictures of the illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have some queries as these are also somewhat complex, so thank you for bearing with me. The first one is inspired by something that our friends of Halos said in our last session, so I’ll read you the quote. […]

excerpts.t: The beauty of the creation and the game of manyness is that the Creator, you, may seem to have this experience; may seem to look back upon yourself as infinity, identified with a particular focal point of form, and thus relate to and behold and glory in infinity. And in this glory, radiate a sense of beauty and awe and thanksgiving.
excerpts.q: Yeah, thank you, Q’uo. This query I’ve been trying to form as you’ve been talking, so I apologize if it’s not fully formed. But within that response, you recognized faith with terms such as formless, absent of resistance, totally free, unthinking. […]

excerpts.t: Indeed, it is true that challenge and difficulty is fodder for growth for the mind/body/spirit complex, and for your planet as a whole being. But we would ask, if you have within your direct perception an entity suffering, and the impulse you feel is to relieve that suffering, and it is within your means to do so, would you feel called to immediately relieve the entities suffering? And if so, where does this call come from? Is it your personal will that you wish to see their suffering end, or is it the will of the Creator that moves you, that brings you compassion, and allows you to move your mind/body/spirit complex in order that the other entity may cease its suffering?
excerpts.q: Yes, I have a question. Thank you, Q’uo, for your willingness to serve the One Infinite Creator. My question is regarding a prayer that a friend of mine repeats about world peace. And what I run up against is having experienced so much growth as a result of a lack of personal peace and suffering. […]

excerpts.t: So if you can set your intention to share whatever you share, to teach them to listen on the basis of your love, the Creator’s love flowing through you, then you will be communicating with the Creator within each child, whether it is kindergarten, grade school, junior high. The more this can be done at an earlier age, the more the love of the Creator becomes a foundation for the child to do everything the child will ever do, and most of what children do is listen and then repeat what they’ve heard and to amplify it with that love that you have given them.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo, for listening to us. I’m tasked with teaching young children new ways to listen, and I’m just seeking any wisdom or perspective you might have on teaching children in elementary and intermediate school about ways to listen better.

excerpts.t: However, from our perspective, there is indeed a great positive aspect of the concept of worship for the seeker on the positive path. Indeed, we would say that in some way, any positive seeker who is dedicated to a path of spiritual seeking may, in one way or the other, find themselves in worship, whether intentionally so or not.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I am hoping you can expand on the idea of worship in relation to the One Infinite Creator. I often find that when I think about that word, my mind goes to some Old Testament entity baggage with the idea of worship, and I wonder if you could expand on it beyond that?

excerpts.t: And though they are illusory, they still exist. The necessity of the will to pierce this illusion still exists. It is in this necessity, and the expression of your will as worship of the One Infinite Creator, that allows you to more fully embody this connection; to dissolve more and more of this illusion so that you may, as you walk the veiled path within the third density, be more innate in your connection with the One Infinite Creator. You may walk in faith, allowing this illusory distance between the self and the Creator to have less of an influence, so that your own personal will may be in alignment with that of the One Infinite Creator.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I am hoping you can expand on the idea of worship in relation to the One Infinite Creator. I often find that when I think about that word, my mind goes to some Old Testament entity baggage with the idea of worship, and I wonder if you could expand on it beyond that?

excerpts.t: Trust yourself, trust your heart, trust the pureness of the love you feel whenever you meditate upon it, and know that you are, by your very nature, and by asking this question, setting a pure intention towards making big decisions in your life with compassion, with a mind towards service. Have faith in your ability and give yourself much grace, much patience.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. When there are decisions to be made in life, how do you recognize which one is the most full of love, contains the best and highest good? How do you recognize that?

excerpts.t: Sometimes decisions or changes in life require more than just a single meditation or a single space of contemplation. Perhaps it takes many; perhaps it comes out of nowhere and it hits you like a ton of bricks, you may say, and you realize what is at the core is this central feeling within you, that you are worthy, that you are full of love and made by love, and that you invest love in this path.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. When there are decisions to be made in life, how do you recognize which one is the most full of love, contains the best and highest good? How do you recognize that?

excerpts.t: If you can make that connection with your higher self that exists at the mid-sixth density level, you are communicating with a portion of yourself that has traveled this journey in many ways. The higher self has, you might say, a map of how you have traveled it in one way and another. If you can make a contact with your higher self, then know that what you receive in that contact can help you move forward through the difficulties, the catalyst of your journey. For this is how you grow: not by the good times, but by the difficult times.
excerpts.q: Hi, Q’uo, I have a question, a two-parter. First of all, how important is it in our third-density selves to connect to our higher self, love, intelligences; and secondly, are there ways that you would suggest communing with that part of us?

excerpts.t: As to the incarnate actor’s relationship to creativity, is this an internal property of the third-density entity’s conscious mind or subconscious layers? Or is it something impersonal, transpersonal, that exists in the ethers, so to speak, to which the third-density entity becomes receptive and a vessel for?
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. There is a notion out there that creativity and creative thought is outside of ourselves, and that we are receptacles for it. And I would just would like to hear what Q’uo’s thoughts about that, or what Q’uo thinks about that?

excerpts.t: As you may know, the body, if it comes into contact with an external source that triggers pain, will reflexively pull away from that source. However, it gets complex and complicated when this biological basis is intertwined with the mind complex, the storytelling complex, the identity-making complex, which finds meaning in pain, and the layers of pain that the mind creates, which one may call suffering of an emotional or a mental nature, such that this pain can be amplified, and this mind—informed by that basic, rudimentary impulse to run away from pain—can make a habit of this in one’s mental patterns such that it itself is, shall we say, carved into the neural pathways of the brain and the nervous system; that it becomes habituated and can be transposed onto those sources of pain which are purely of an emotional and non-physical nature, i.e., the mistreatment or the abuse, perceived […]
excerpts.q: I’ve got one, if nobody else has one. Q’uo, I’ve been wondering about the natural tendency of people to avoid suffering and avoid difficulty, and in the light of the fact that a lot of our spiritual growth comes through suffering and difficulty, and I’m primarily curious right now about the sort of biological mechanisms that have trained us to avoid pain, avoid discomfort, and avoid suffering. […]

excerpts.t: A mind or entity who has not made, or done much work to make, their catalyst and their thinking and their beingness conscious will largely live a life unconsciously, reacting to catalyst and the body’s proclivity to avoid pain unconsciously. And the mind’s proclivity to carry that forward will mutually energize one another and reinforce one another such that catalysts of a mental and emotional nature may show up in the body—that is, the body may react to that catalyst of a mental nature, which is not being processed.
excerpts.q: I’ve got one, if nobody else has one. Q’uo, I’ve been wondering about the natural tendency of people to avoid suffering and avoid difficulty, and in the light of the fact that a lot of our spiritual growth comes through suffering and difficulty, and I’m primarily curious right now about the sort of biological mechanisms that have trained us to avoid pain, avoid discomfort, and avoid suffering. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we are aware of the query, my sister. We find this query very interesting, for this perception that you have described within your query is not typical, you may say, of the third-density entity. It is a unique perception that allows you to perceive these other beings, and we find that in circumstances, as you have described, in your role as a healer, many people or entities who you serve will have many attachments, you may say. There may be many types of inner planes entities that latch on to certain distortions that may cause people to seek healing, and thus, we find that you would be in a rich environment full of other beings attempting to both serve and to take advantage of the distortions being healed within your environment.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I work in mental health care and have had experience with spiritual visitors of people who I’m with. When I enter into a client’s room, I can feel and notice spiritual visitors drawing my attention. I was wondering how to balance listening and valuing those visiting the client spiritually while also devoting my attention to those in third density, who I’m there to serve. […]

excerpts.t: And, indeed, there is a biological recoiling from the experience of pain. For it is an important signal or point of instruction for the second-density entity that tells them about their environment and what to be avoided, if we may speak simplistically. And to a degree, this does carry over into the third-density experience as the body itself and one’s neurology reacts to move the self away from pain.
excerpts.q: I’ve got one, if nobody else has one. Q’uo, I’ve been wondering about the natural tendency of people to avoid suffering and avoid difficulty, and in the light of the fact that a lot of our spiritual growth comes through suffering and difficulty, and I’m primarily curious right now about the sort of biological mechanisms that have trained us to avoid pain, avoid discomfort, and avoid suffering. […]

excerpts.t: Allowing individuals to exist within their body without pain is indeed a noble goal. However, we can say that, from our perspective—that is, [one] privileged to be removed from the grappling hooks of such pain and such stories around pain—that the pain itself does indeed have a divine purpose. That this pain is not a punishment or a random difficulty inflicted upon you as a peoples to experience and to try to eliminate without question. We do understand and believe it is a noble service to attempt to eliminate pain, however, as we witness, it is an impossible goal, for physical pain is a fact of reality. And for many, such as yourself, the chronic type of pain that is overwhelming can be a massive disruption to the personal life.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I have a question regarding physical pain. Sometimes you can have situations where the pain can be crippling and I was wondering if you could speak in general on how do you integrate that pain and try to keep a positive attitude about the situation that you’re in? Because sometimes it can get to be overwhelming. And it’s something that I’m struggling with quite a bit. […]

excerpts.t: It is also a good idea that before you have your channeling sessions, which you hold in the same place each time, if you provide a kind of purification of the place, and a protection of the place that you could do by various rituals, such as the Banishing Ritual of the Lesser Pentagram. Or if you have any other kind of ritual that you set your intention to use it as a means of providing a wall of light that does not allow any darkness within it. This then prepares the place much like the tuning that you would do before such a channeling.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. Some of us are also interested in developing an in-person conscious verbal channeling group to channel our inner guides. For the session process, we’re thinking of first clearing the space, establishing protection, doing a guided meditation to enter into a positive meditative state, and then welcoming our guides to blend with us. How do we know when to start channeling? […]

excerpts.t: To speak generally, as you have requested, we again can recommend an understanding or an exploration of this experience that focuses on the potential planning of such catalyst from before your incarnation. There are various reasons why an entity may put into their incarnational plan an experience of overwhelming pain. There are various reasons why an entity may experience any number of limitations or overwhelming experience. And indeed, it is our perception that many entities, prior to their incarnation, overestimate their ability to see through this overwhelming nature of the catalyst, and grapple—we correct this instrument—and grasp the true intended meaning of this catalyst.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I have a question regarding physical pain. Sometimes you can have situations where the pain can be crippling and I was wondering if you could speak in general on how do you integrate that pain and try to keep a positive attitude about the situation that you’re in? Because sometimes it can get to be overwhelming. And it’s something that I’m struggling with quite a bit. […]

excerpts.t: You may be aware that we consistently recommend the daily practice of meditation to help understand the types of experiences like this. For they come to you from a ground of being that is most accessible through meditation. To become more familiar with your inner landscape, to develop and to polish and to maintain a room within the self, within the heart, to meditate within that space, within the self, and to bless it with your love allows for things to come into that space. New understandings, new information, and even perhaps new experiences that help bring more understanding of why you had this experience, and who this experience was with, and the origins of the being that you are curious about understanding more.
excerpts.q: Hi, Q’uo, I have a question. When I was 19, I had an out-of-body experience, and I came into contact with what I believe to be a positively oriented extraterrestrial entity, and I’m curious if you could tell me about the origins of this entity and their brothers, and what my relationship to them may be?

excerpts.t: This anger is a powerful source of energy. It is what the creation has not been created of but which has been a part of the creation of the One Infinite Creator since time began. For it is so easy to get angry at anyone or anything. The power of anger can be used by the spiritual seeker of truth to feel that anger for the self, to feel its power, to bask in its power, to then see that there is a way in which anger can become part of yourself, so that you can work with it as catalyst. You can see whatever one is angry at, whether it is your own being, another being, another country, or so forth, and then see that this anger helps the Creator to know Itself in one way.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, help us better understand anger. There seems to be a disproportionate amount of anger in the world. We are taught to accept and learn to love anger like all emotions, distilling its purity. Going a step further, how can we integrate this energy? Can we transmute it? What is anger’s rightful place in the human experience?

excerpts.t: But these three distortions resulted in a creation that we have called an illusion, and it is indeed an illusion. For how can infinity, which is unity, have an awareness of itself? In order to be aware, there must be something to be aware of, which then implies two-ness or finiteness. Indeed, that then implies that the infinite creation that you are a part of is in this sense an illusion. The seeming separation, the distance between the subject of you and whatever you are perceiving as object, is an illusion, but it is a divine illusion.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. That was beautiful. Can you comment on the infinity of the body? I have an easier time understanding the infinity of the mind and of the spirit. The physical vessel seems most limited to me. If we each contain the whole, is that our vessel or does that mean the physical material of the universe, stars, planets? Is that all considered the body of the individual?

excerpts.t: This is the path that each of you will take at one time or another. For anger is a part of the third-density illusion that each of you lives beyond the veil of forgetting. The veil of forgetting hides that there is no need for anger, but the anger that you feel is one way that you can move forward on your spiritual journey of reunion with the One Infinite Creator by feeling the love for all around you that you before felt anger for.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, help us better understand anger. There seems to be a disproportionate amount of anger in the world. We are taught to accept and learn to love anger like all emotions, distilling its purity. Going a step further, how can we integrate this energy? Can we transmute it? What is anger’s rightful place in the human experience?

excerpts.t: And in this individualization and focus and limitation, that which is not known, that is, the unknown, calls to the self; and the choices made upon this journey, of being called by and seeking the unknown, of seeking the truth, of seeking to experience the heart of love, offer the One the opportunity of novelty.
excerpts.q: While honoring the law of confusion, the Confederation often speaks of the One Infinite Creator, knowing Itself through the experience of its portions. Yet, the Creator is also described as infinite and complete. Could you please speak about how seekers may understand this apparent paradox between an infinite creator and the appearance of new experience within creation? […]

excerpts.t: We appreciate further the framing that you have put within this question of the dynamics of healing these distortions and wounds, and the responsibility that one may have of healing not just oneself, but of offering healing to others. This is an incredibly important aspect and dynamic of this question, for it is our understanding and opinion that a healer who wishes to offer healing to others must find some minimal amount of balance and healing within the self, so that they may then offer such healing in an undistorted and open way for any other-self, that they may seek to heal or that they may seek to serve. Indeed, healing is the ultimate service, and any act of service that provides catalyst for an other-self to come to know themselves in a deeper way, whether it is understood as healing or any other type of expression is still, in many ways, healing.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Yeah, lately I’ve been experiencing feelings of anger, resentment, and impatience toward men and masculine energy, and as I sit with these feelings, I notice they seem connected to concerns with fairness and justice and an unequal distribution of responsibility. […]

excerpts.t: We know that fear is incredibly present on your planet for many reasons, and in many instances. Finding beauty outside of fear may be of help. Recognize that your fear is that lesson, a great gift, and that there’s much beauty, even in that fear. What an opportunity you have been gifted to experience fear, because it reminds you of all that you love.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you. Q’uo, how can the mind/body/spirit complex balance and heal catalyst involving fear for its physical life, such as being pursued, threatened, or moved into harmful action toward an other-self in order to preserve its own life? To make an example, let’s say, while driving behind a logging truck, the mind can imagine the wood falling and causing injury or death. […]

excerpts.t: You can allow those things to exist as their own distortions, as their own baggage, you may say, and you may radiate and express the love and the light of the One Infinite Creator, as it is known to you, and they may not feel satisfied with this radiation of your love, however you express it, but you may rest knowing that you have done your best; and you continue to walk the path of desiring to serve within your own power, within your own ability; and knowing that you will continue to seek this love within every moment, even if the other that you are attempting to serve does not recognize or see this love.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Yeah, lately I’ve been experiencing feelings of anger, resentment, and impatience toward men and masculine energy, and as I sit with these feelings, I notice they seem connected to concerns with fairness and justice and an unequal distribution of responsibility. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo. We greet this circle in the love and in the light of the One Infinite Creator. We are honored and grateful to be invited to join you in this sacred circle of seeking. We are called to this group, not just through your explicit request for us to join you in your seeking, but also by the desire within your hearts that resonates with the desire in our hearts, that is the desire to love and to serve, and ultimately to discover the One Infinite Creator, and allow the Creator’s love and light to flow through you in service to others.
excerpts.q: How fairness relates to love in imbalanced gender dynamics of injustice; why discomfort‑bringing creatures exist and how to meet them with compassion while protecting oneself; how to work with fear‑based catalyst and integrate automatic fear responses.

excerpts.t: This Love is your healer, and with that heart open, that infinite surgeon may work through you. For Love is of an intelligence incomprehensibly greater than incarnate intelligence. You are inside of Love. You are held by Love; and Love uses you, shall we say, It works through you. This Love is the Creator’s Love, felt by you as a separate being. And this Love, if you follow it, if you allow it, if you are with it and see where it leads you, like your breadcrumbs in the fairy tale, shall we say, this Love will lead you back to the Creator which Loves you and which you love, but may not yet know it consciously.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I’ve sometimes felt confused with the concept of love in the Law of One between the true primal nature of the Creator, which has been described as beautiful and terrible, creative and destructive, and the love we are told to share with self and other-self, which is usually understood as unconditional love as well as compassion, generosity, kindness, and fellowship, etc. […]

excerpts.t: Those of you who walk this incarnation with a broken heart or pain or baggage due to the parent-child relationship, we ask that you lovingly tend to that hurt child. That you approach that inner child with the same grace that a most loving and accepting parent would. That you treat that inner child in the way that you wish you had been treated, with full love and acceptance, with patience and grace, with understanding, and of course, always with affirmations of perfection.
excerpts.q: Yes, can you speak to the spiritual nature of family relationships, specifically parents and children? How do we best analyze this unique relationship for spiritual revelation?

excerpts.t: We cannot, shall we say, inhabit your soul, be, or occupy your mind/body/spirit complex and stop the thoughts for you or rather divest your awareness from identification with thought. But we can assist your own efforts, and we do every time we are called. We seek to strengthen your efforts. We seek to stabilize your seeking. We, shall we say, model silence for you from silence to your silence. That silence, that stillness is within you always.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a question on behalf of the group. As always, thank you for being with us. Some of us have never experienced deep and true silence. We were hoping could you help us, even for only a few seconds, to experience the Creator through deep silence?

excerpts.t: This love of the green ray includes those qualities which you named, question-asker: the fellowship, the community, and so forth. This love binds that-which-seemed-to-be-separate together in shared story, shared identity, shared mission and purpose. This love is the salvation of your world. Its absence and abuse and rejection are at the root of the dysfunction and mental, shall we say, illness of your world, and the disharmony and the suffering layered upon suffering, layered upon suffering.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I’ve sometimes felt confused with the concept of love in the Law of One between the true primal nature of the Creator, which has been described as beautiful and terrible, creative and destructive, and the love we are told to share with self and other-self, which is usually understood as unconditional love as well as compassion, generosity, kindness, and fellowship, etc. […]

excerpts.t: The more that the entity activates their heart and widens the scope of love to a universality, to learning to give without expectation of return, to learning to hold life in love with less and less, and ultimately no condition, the more that the higher centers are activated and this love is brought upward; the more that the entity radiates this love and light and light and love without effort, by virtue of their beingness, as we spoke previously. And this emanation is one’s most fundamental and profound service.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. On December 29, 2007, you are recorded as saying, and I quote: For you heard the cry of earth, and you hope to hold the light at this time in a dark world, so that gradually, as you allow the light of the Creator to shine through you, you could infect others with this joy and effortless flow of life and love that is coming through each of you at all times. […]

excerpts.t: For it is not just this spherical body of first and second density which needs [most] healed, it is your peoples. And those actions which help to uplift those upon your planet, to heal broken hearts, to heal drug addiction, and the pathologies of the mind, and the punitive justice system, and to heal and transform the economic incentives that perpetuate this world-destroying machine, and so on, are available.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. What can we do to alleviate the climate issues currently besetting our planet: fires, excessive heat, drought, floods, etc.?

excerpts.t: That is not to say that you won’t encounter rainy days. But when you find pure acceptance, you’ll also find easier access to faith.
